# VisWiz 1.8.0 release checklist

- [x] Commerce Data Builder merged into the release branch.
- [x] Automatic updates no longer forced on by VisWiz.
- [x] Native WordPress per-plugin auto-update preference remains authoritative unless `VISWIZ_AUTO_UPDATES` is explicitly defined.
- [x] VisWiz update preference UI added for single-site and multisite/network administration.
- [x] Plugin header and `VISWIZ_VERSION` bumped to 1.8.0.
- [x] Release workflow validates every PHP and JavaScript source file before packaging.
- [ ] Pull-request CI passes.
- [ ] Merge to `main`.
- [ ] GitHub Release `v1.8.0` publishes an installable `viswiz-1.8.0.zip` asset.
